name: asterism
description: Plugins for developing on the asterism repository.

plugins.name: prose-shape
plugins.description: Refuses a write that hard-wraps a pull request or issue body, which GitHub folds itself and no gate over the tree can see.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: The three reviews this repository asks for before a commit: what may be published, whether the change does what its issue asked, and whether the prose beside the code is still true.
